title: ChannelForge Provider Source Configuration
description: Shape contract for provider.json / provider.local.json / provider.example.json (see Read-ChannelForgeProvider.ps1). This validates structure only. It does not enforce the URL trust-boundary rules (scheme allowlist, no credentials, no loopback/private/link-local hosts) — those are runtime checks in Test-ChannelForgeSourceUrl.ps1 and must stay there even if this schema is also used in CI.

_comment.description: Optional documentation note used by template/example files. Ignored by Read-ChannelForgeProvider.

base_url.description: Informational base URL prefix shared by sources. Not read by Read-ChannelForgeProvider; documentation only.

name.description: Source name, e.g. 'Sports'. Must be unique within the file.

group.description: Optional grouping label, often the same as name.

url.description: Provider source URL. Treated as a secret outside example/placeholder files (see docs/reference/SECURITY.md); use https://example.invalid/... in any tracked file.

enabled.description: Whether this source is included in a build.
